description: Universal document ingest into a layered MD-Blocks artefact (nConvert, Rust core). Converts anything thrown at it into a self-contained item under storage 'ingest/': summary.md (L0, retrieval summary), document.md (L1, structured text), assets/ and pages/ (L2, visuals), original file (L3, byte-exact), and item.json (the manifest with identity, provenance, layers). Optional depth:'deep' renders every PDF page with PDFium and has a vision model reconstruct structure over the mechanically extracted text. Magic-byte detection is authoritative; unknown or corrupt input fails loudly with a diagnosis. Phase M1 formats: txt, csv, tsv, md (validated passthrough), json, yaml, toml, xml. PDF is live; html, office formats, e-books, mail, OCR follow.

tools.name: nconvert_convert
tools.description: Ingest one file into a layered artefact under storage 'ingest/'. Produces original.<ext> (provenance copy), summary.md (L0 retrieval summary), document.md (L1 MD-Blocks + conversion frontmatter), meta.json (detection verdict, stats, all warnings), item.json (manifest), and assets/ when the format carries binaries. With depth 'deep' (PDF) it additionally renders every page to pages/ with PDFium and has a vision model reconstruct structure — headings, tables, figure placement — over the mechanically extracted text, keeping document.mechanical.md beside the result and validating text coverage per chunk. Detection is by magic bytes; the extension only breaks ties. Unknown formats, corrupt containers and limit breaches are hard errors carrying the diagnosis. Read the warnings in the response: they mark every absorbed variance.

path.description: Storage-relative path (or absolute path) of the file to ingest.

depth.description: mechanical (default): deterministic text + embedded-image extraction. deep (PDF only): renders every page with PDFium and has a vision model reconstruct structure over the mechanically extracted text. Deep keeps document.mechanical.md beside the result and reports per-chunk text coverage.

assets.description: Extract binary assets (images, audio, video, attachments) into assets/. Default true.

keepOriginal.description: Copy the source file into the item as original.<ext> (layer L3). Default true.

ocr.description: OCR provider name for scans/photos (capability contract in §11 D1 of the spec). Providers land in M5; the default will be gateway vision.

name.description: Slug for the item folder base name. Defaults to the source filename.

force.description: Reconvert even when the same bytes were already ingested with the same engine and settings. Default false — an identical repeat submit returns the existing item and spends no compute.

tools.name: nconvert_enqueue
tools.description: Submit an ingest job — identical routing to nconvert.convert (mechanical converts inline and returns the full artefact report; deep or oversized input is QUEUED and returns a job handle instead of blocking for minutes). Alias of nconvert.convert, named for clients that want to express async intent.

path.description: Storage-relative path (or absolute path) of the file to ingest.

depth.description: mechanical (default): inline. deep (PDF): queued — one heavy job runs at a time.

force.description: Reconvert even when the same bytes were already ingested with the same engine and settings.

tools.name: nconvert_jobs
tools.description: List ingest jobs: the queue (queued/running, with live positions) and recent history, newest first. Running jobs show their active step (rendering 4/82, vision 2/11 with coverage).

tools.name: nconvert_job
tools.description: One job in detail: full step list with statuses and per-step i/n progress, result item or error, cancellation state.

id.description: Job id from nconvert.convert/enqueue or nconvert.jobs.

tools.name: nconvert_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job. Queued jobs cancel immediately; running jobs stop at the next checkpoint (between steps or page chunks) — deep chunks are the natural boundaries.

tools.name: nconvert_capabilities
tools.description: Live format matrix: which formats convert now, which are detected-but-pending (with their milestone phase), the limits in force, the converter version, and deep-conversion status. Call this before throwing an exotic file at nconvert_convert.

tools.name: nconvert_items
tools.description: List ingested items (the artefact registry), newest first: id, source, format, depth, section/page counts and which layers each item carries. This is the discovery entry point for the ingested corpus.

tools.name: nconvert_fetch
tools.description: Read one layer of an ingested item. Layers, cheapest first: 'summary' (L0 retrieval summary — start here), 'document' (L1 full MD-Blocks text, or a single section with section:N), 'mechanical' (deterministic conversion for comparison), 'rejected' (legacy only: a vision reconstruction the old coverage guard refused, on items ingested before 2026-11-07 — the guard is a diagnostic now, so new items never carry this layer), 'page' (L2 rasterized page image path, page:N), 'asset' (L2 extracted image/attachment path, asset:"name"), 'original' (L3 byte-exact source path). Text layers return content; binary layers return a storage path and URL for the caller to open, attach, or ingest.

item.description: Item id (the folder name from nconvert_items).

layer.description: Which layer to read. Defaults to summary. 'rejected' returns the vision reconstruction the coverage guard refused (kept for comparison, e.g. a scan whose text layer is itself OCR noise) — pass section: N when several chunks were rejected. 'verification' returns the independent audit report.

section.description: For layer=document: 0-based section index (MD-Blocks sections; for PDFs one per page).

asset.description: For layer=asset: asset filename inside assets/.

maxChars.description: For layer=document: truncate long documents and point at section fetching.

tools.name: nconvert_verify
tools.description: Independent audit of an already-ingested item: a large-context model reads the shipped document.md together with the text layer, the mechanical document and any refused readings, then reports what survived, what is at risk, whether the numbers are internally consistent, and — explicitly — what it could not check without the page images. The report lands as verification.md and the verdict (confidence: high|medium|low) is recorded in item.json. Deep ingests do not audit themselves (agents.nconvert.verify defaults to false — one large-model call per document), so run this when an item's trustworthiness matters or when re-checking an older or mechanical-only item.

item.description: Item id (the folder name from nconvert.items).

model.description: Override the verification model for this run. Default: agents.nconvert.verifyModel (kimi-k31-chat), then verifyFallbackModels.

force.description: Re-run the audit even when verification.md already exists.
